cohort: 79 patients who underwent elective surgery at 24 weeks of pregnancy or more after a diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorder (creta, increta, or percreta) at a center in Turkey between May 2, 2010, and August 10, 2016.
finding: Leaving the placenta in situ resulted in the lowest total blood loss and amount of blood products transfused, with similar surgical complication rates and uterine preservation rates compared to placental removal and conservative surgery.
